metadata.title: $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$-cohomology on multidifferential operators space
metadata.abstract: We compute cohomology spaces of the ortosymplectic Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$ on the (1,1)-dimensional real superspace with coefficients in the superspace $\frak{D}_{{\lambda},\mu}$ of $n$-ary differential operators acting on weighted densities (${\lambda}\in\mathbb{R}^n$ and $\mu\in\mathbb{R}$).
